SEARCH
Package org.checkerframework.framework.stub

Class BinaryStubReader

java.lang.Object
org.checkerframework.framework.stub.BinaryStubReader
public class BinaryStubReader extends Object
Applies annotation data from a BinaryStubData.ClassRecord to a checker's AnnotationFileParser.AnnotationFileAnnotations. This translates the compact structural binary representation back into AnnotationMirror and AnnotatedTypeMirror objects that the framework uses during type-checking, matching the semantics of the text-based AnnotationFileParser. It serves both the annotated JDK (annotated-jdk.bin.gz, applied lazily per requested class) and the built-in checker stub files (*.astub.bin.gz, applied eagerly at checker initialization with @FromStubFile marking).

Annotations that cannot be resolved (e.g. JDK-internal annotations like @DefinedBy that are absent from the annotation-processor classpath) are silently skipped, matching the behavior of the text-based AnnotationFileParser. Annotations that are not supported qualifiers of the current checker are filtered out by AnnotatedTypeMirror.addAnnotation(AnnotationMirror) when they are applied to a type.

User-supplied stub files take precedence: if an entry already exists in AnnotationFileParser.AnnotationFileAnnotations.atypes it is not overwritten, and declaration annotations are merged by annotation name rather than replaced.

A stub method that the enclosing class only inherits is applied as a fake override (see applyFakeOverride(org.checkerframework.framework.stub.BinaryStubData.TypeAnno[], java.lang.String, javax.lang.model.element.TypeElement, java.lang.String, org.checkerframework.framework.stub.BinaryStubData, org.checkerframework.framework.type.AnnotatedTypeFactory, org.checkerframework.framework.stub.AnnotationFileElementTypes, org.checkerframework.framework.stub.AnnotationFileParser.AnnotationFileAnnotations)). Classes that are not present in the binary stub -- e.g. a file the writer failed to serialize, or a user-supplied -Astubs file, which is always text-parsed -- fall through to the text-based AnnotationFileParser path.

Semantic equivalence of this class and the text parser is enforced by BinaryStubDiffChecker (option -AbinaryStubDiffCheck); run NullnessBinaryStubDiffTest after changing either side.

  • Method Details

    • applyPackageAndModuleRecords

      public static void applyPackageAndModuleRecords(BinaryStubData data, AnnotatedTypeFactory atypeFactory, AnnotationFileElementTypes elementTypes, AnnotationFileParser.AnnotationFileAnnotations target, boolean fromLazyJdk)
      Applies the package and module annotations from the binary stub data. Called eagerly when the binary stub file is loaded, because package and module annotations are global rather than per-class.

      Declaration annotations are merged into target.declAnnos by annotation name; see mergeDeclAnnos(org.checkerframework.framework.stub.AnnotationFileParser.AnnotationFileAnnotations, java.lang.String, org.checkerframework.javacutil.AnnotationMirrorSet, boolean) for how fromLazyJdk controls which source wins a conflict.

      Parameters:
      data - the complete binary stub data, providing the string pool and annotation pool
      atypeFactory - the factory used to create types and parse annotations
      elementTypes - per-factory state, including the annotation-mirror cache
      target - the annotation container to store the results in
      fromLazyJdk - true if data is the lazily-loaded annotated JDK (called from prepJdkStubs); false if it is an eagerly-applied built-in stub file (called from applyBinaryStubData)

    • applyClassTypeParamRecords

      public static void applyClassTypeParamRecords(BinaryStubData.ClassRecord cr, String className, AnnotatedTypeFactory atypeFactory, AnnotationFileElementTypes elementTypes, BinaryStubData data, AnnotationFileParser.AnnotationFileAnnotations target, @Nullable AnnotationMirror fromStubFileAnno)
      Stores the class's type parameter declarations from cr in target, unless target already has them, as applyClassRecord(org.checkerframework.framework.stub.BinaryStubData.ClassRecord, java.lang.String, org.checkerframework.framework.type.AnnotatedTypeFactory, org.checkerframework.framework.stub.AnnotationFileElementTypes, org.checkerframework.framework.stub.BinaryStubData, org.checkerframework.framework.stub.AnnotationFileParser.AnnotationFileAnnotations) would. Callers apply this to every class record of a stub file, or of an annotated JDK source file, before applying any record in full, because a plain ? takes the bounds of its type variable's declaration (AnnotationFileParser.annotateUnannotatedUnboundedWildcard(org.checkerframework.framework.type.AnnotatedTypeMirror.AnnotatedWildcardType, org.checkerframework.framework.type.AnnotatedTypeFactory)), which can be in a class whose record comes later, such as a nested class. The text parser processes a file in order, so it gets the stub's bounds only for a declaration that precedes the ?.
      Parameters:
      cr - the class record from the binary stub data
      className - the fully-qualified name of the class
      atypeFactory - the factory used to create types and parse annotations
      elementTypes - per-factory state, including the annotation-mirror cache
      data - the complete binary stub data
      target - the annotation container to store the results in
      fromStubFileAnno - the @FromStubFile mirror for a stub file, or null for the annotated JDK

      public static void applyClassRecord(BinaryStubData.ClassRecord cr, String className, AnnotatedTypeFactory atypeFactory, AnnotationFileElementTypes elementTypes, BinaryStubData data, AnnotationFileParser.AnnotationFileAnnotations target, @Nullable AnnotationMirror fromStubFileAnno)
      Like applyClassRecord(BinaryStubData.ClassRecord, String, AnnotatedTypeFactory, AnnotationFileElementTypes, BinaryStubData, AnnotationFileAnnotations), but additionally marks every matched method and field element with the given @FromStubFile mirror. Used for built-in checker stub files, whose elements the text parser marks (see AnnotationFileParser.markAsFromStubFile); the annotated JDK is never marked.
      Parameters:
      cr - the class record from the binary stub data
      className - the fully-qualified name of the class
      atypeFactory - the factory used to create types and parse annotations
      elementTypes - per-factory state, including the annotation-mirror cache
      data - the complete binary stub data, providing the string pool and annotation pool
      target - the annotation container to store the results in
      fromStubFileAnno - the @FromStubFile mirror to mark matched members with, or null to not mark (the annotated-JDK case)
